title: Trump faces Iran war Congress deadline
original_summary: This Friday marks 60 days since Donald Trump formally notified Congress on March 2 of the start of hostilities against Iran, triggering the timeline set by the War Powers Resolution, which requires congressional approval to continue military action beyond that period.
